mapper.select: SELECT a.*, b.intg_cd_dp_val_desc AS que_stt_nm, c.usr_nm AS que_usr_nm, c.usr_eml AS que_usr_eml, d.usr_nm AS ans_usr_nm, d.usr_eml AS ans_usr_eml, 1 as no FROM que_mgmt a LEFT JOIN com_intg_cd_dtl b ON ( b.intg_cd = 'CD00010' AND a.que_sts_cd = b.intg_cd_val_ctnt ) LEFT JOIN usr_mgmt c ON ( a.que_usr_id = c.usr_id ) LEFT JOIN usr_mgmt d ON ( a.ans_usr_id = d.usr_id ) WHERE a.que_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO que_mgmt ( que_sts_cd, que_usr_id, que_tit, que_ctnt, que_atch_url, cre_usr_id, cre_dt, upd_usr_id, upd_dt ) VALUES ( #{queSttCd}, #{queUsrId}, #{queTit}, #{queCtnt}, #{queAtchUrl}, #{creUsrId}, #{creDt}, #{updUsrId}, #{updDt} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE que_mgmt
que_sts_cd = #{queSttCd},
que_usr_id = #{queUsrId},
que_tit = #{queTit},
que_ctnt = #{queCtnt},
ans_usr_id = #{ansUsrId},
ans_ctnt = #{ansCtnt},
que_atch_url = #{queAtchUrl},
upd_usr_id = #{updUsrId},
upd_dt = #{updDt},
WHERE que_id = #{queId}
